summary: Design practical AI agents, workflows, and controls in 5 days. Build real artefacts with LangGraph, MCP, and evaluation templates.
lede: AI agent and agentic workflow design structures systems to plan tasks, use tools and coordinate multi-step work. This course is for professionals designing, evaluating or governing agents in operational settings, and focuses on turning business processes into workflows with decision points, controls and recovery paths. You’ll practice selecting and specifying tools, designing memory and human-approval checkpoints, and assessing task success through evaluation, logging and rollout plans.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to design, evaluate, or govern AI agents and agentic workflows in operational settings.
prerequisites: You should have intermediate digital workflow literacy and a working understanding of AI concepts such as prompts, tools, APIs, and structured outputs. Basic Python familiarity is helpful for examples and lab-style exercises, but deep software engineering experience is not required for the design-level outputs in this course. A laptop is required, and comfort working with diagrams, checklists, and structured process maps will help you complete the exercises efficiently.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
